title: Mark Zuckerberg Posts 6,500-Word AI Essay
content_html:
Mark Zuckerberg Posts 6,500-Word AI Essay

Two weeks ago Zuckerberg published a 1,000-word essay, “The AI Future Is for Everyone”. This week he published an expanded 6,500-word version of the essay on Meta’s website. Somehow it almost says nothing more than the original. This tidbit, however, struck me as notable:

For example, in Richland Parish, Louisiana, where Meta is building a large data center, teachers received a $50,000 bonus this year because of the increased tax revenue from our investment. The superintendent told us that teachers are now moving there from across the country and he believes it will become one of the nation’s best school districts.

Unlike the concern about knowledge work displacement, there is a shortage of skilled tradespeople like carpenters, electricians, and construction workers to support the demand for infrastructure buildout. Meta has created America’s Workforce Academy to provide free training for skilled tradespeople and guaranteed high-paying jobs in the areas we’re building data centers.

Those $50K bonuses to public-school teachers are real, and they’re more than most of those teachers’ annual salaries. That’s the sort of thing that could turn public sentiment on data center construction around. But it hasn’t turned around yet.

★ Tuesday, 11 August 2026

sentences.zh: 两周前，扎克伯格发表了一篇 1000 字的文章，《人工智能的未来属于每个人》。

sentences.en: This week he published an expanded 6,500-word version of the essay on Meta’s website.
sentences.zh: 本周，他在 Meta 网站上发布了这篇文章的 6,500 字扩展版本。

sentences.zh: 不知何故，它几乎只说了原话。

sentences.en: This tidbit, however, struck me as notable: For example, in Richland Parish, Louisiana, where Meta is building a large data center, teachers received a $50,000 bonus this year because of the increased tax revenue from our investment.
sentences.zh: 然而，这个消息让我印象深刻：例如，在路易斯安那州的里奇兰教区，Meta 正在那里建造一个大型数据中心，由于我们的投资增加了税收收入，教师今年获得了 50,000 美元的奖金。

sentences.en: The superintendent told us that teachers are now moving there from across the country and he believes it will become one of the nation’s best school districts.
sentences.zh: 学区长告诉我们，教师们现在正从全国各地搬到那里，他相信这里将成为全国最好的学区之一。

sentences.en: Unlike the concern about knowledge work displacement, there is a shortage of skilled tradespeople like carpenters, electricians, and construction workers to support the demand for infrastructure buildout.
sentences.zh: 与对知识型工作取代的担忧不同，木匠、电工和建筑工人等熟练技工缺乏来支持基础设施建设的需求。

sentences.en: Meta has created America’s Workforce Academy to provide free training for skilled tradespeople and guaranteed high-paying jobs in the areas we’re building data centers.
sentences.zh: Meta 创建了美国劳动力学院，为熟练技工提供免费培训，并保证我们正在建设数据中心的地区提供高薪工作。

sentences.en: Those $50K bonuses to public-school teachers are real, and they’re more than most of those teachers’ annual salaries.
sentences.zh: 公立学校教师的 5 万美元奖金是真实的，而且比大多数教师的年薪还要高。

sentences.en: That’s the sort of thing that could turn public sentiment on data center construction around.
sentences.zh: 这可能会扭转公众对数据中心建设的看法。

sentences.en: But it hasn’t turned around yet. ★ Tuesday, 11 August 2026
sentences.zh: 但事情还没有扭转。 ★ 2026 年 8 月 11 日，星期二

content_html_zh:
马克·扎克伯格发表 6,500 字的人工智能论文
两周前，扎克伯格发表了一篇 1000 字的文章，《人工智能的未来属于每个人》。 本周，他在 Meta 网站上发布了这篇文章的 6,500 字扩展版本。 不知何故，它几乎只说了原话。 然而，这个消息让我印象深刻：例如，在路易斯安那州的里奇兰教区，Meta 正在那里建造一个大型数据中心，由于我们的投资增加了税收收入，教师今年获得了 50,000 美元的奖金。 学区长告诉我们，教师们现在正从全国各地搬到那里，他相信这里将成为全国最好的学区之一。 与对知识型工作取代的担忧不同，木匠、电工和建筑工人等熟练技工缺乏来支持基础设施建设的需求。 Meta 创建了美国劳动力学院，为熟练技工提供免费培训，并保证我们正在建设数据中心的地区提供高薪工作。 公立学校教师的 5 万美元奖金是真实的，而且比大多数教师的年薪还要高。 这可能会扭转公众对数据中心建设的看法。 但事情还没有扭转。 ★ 2026 年 8 月 11 日，星期二
